validation: Profile for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8 in TP4 across 4x1 A100-64GB (aggressive: 122B total / 10B active MoE, Gated DeltaNet hybrid attention). Memory text-only: ~123,036M FP8 params + BF16 tail, ~114 GiB total / 4 = ~28.6 GiB/card, vs ~57.6 GiB usable at gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 on 64 GB -> large margin for KV. KV cache is tiny (2 KV heads in gated-attention layers + linear attention), so 32k context + fp8 KV is safe. WARNING, NOT YET GPU-VALIDATED: this kit's runtime is vLLM 0.13.1 (backport sm80), but Qwen3.5 arch qwen3_5_moe was only merged into vLLM 0.17.0 (PR #34110, 2026-02-09; releases 0.17.0+). If the engine refuses the architecture / model_type on startup, a newer sm80-capable runtime (vLLM >= 0.17) must be added to catalog.json first; --language-model-only skips the vision encoder + mm profiling. --enable-expert-parallel + hook nccl_ep follow the dsv4flashablit 4x1 MoE pattern (inter-node EP all2all via PyNCCL caps single-stream throughput on sm80; if throughput disappoints, see skill). --kv-cache-dtype fp8 and --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder may need adjustment pending vLLM 0.17 kwarg names. Trust after a GPU run, not before.
